name: Strategic Narrative Architecture
axiom: Name a shift the audience already feels, then make them choose a side.
trigger: Category creation and enterprise positioning, where the question is not which vendor but which future.

steps.text: Shift: the change in the world that makes the old way obsolete.
Winners and losers: what the shift rewards and punishes.
Promised land: the state the audience wants to reach.
Magic gifts: how this product is the way through.

antiPattern.violation: Declaring a shift the audience has not felt, which sounds like marketing and invites them to argue with the premise instead of the offer.
antiPattern.remediation: Start from evidence they already accept. The shift must be something they could have said themselves.

origin.title: The Greatest Sales Deck I've Ever Seen
